description: All selected clients in a round begin local training from the intended global model state.
evidence: Verified that model parameter extraction, distribution, and local initialization initialize from global parameters without unintended modification.

description: Training Client A must not mutate Client B's local model, another simulation's model, or the global model before aggregation.
evidence: Mutating Client A's parameters leaves Client B's parameters byte-identical and untampered.

description: Local state from round r must not accidentally leak into round r+1 except through intended global aggregation/state.
evidence: Client optimizers are instantiated per round per client; gradients are zeroed at each step; PyTorch computational graphs are freed.

description: Two simulations running concurrently must not share mutable model or optimizer state.
evidence: Server momentum vectors in FedAdam/FedYogi are keyed by unique simulation_id; unkeyed calls run ephemerally without persistent default_sim pollution.

description: Only valid participating client updates for the current round may contribute to aggregation.
evidence: Non-finite (NaN/Inf) client updates are detected and quarantined; valid clients aggregate without poisoning.

description: Weight normalization must use the actual accepted contributing clients and their intended weights (sum n_k * w_k / sum n_k).
evidence: FedAvg aggregation outputs match hand-calculated deterministic oracle and multi-tensor oracle with relative tolerance < 1e-5.

description: A failed or corrupted client must not silently contribute stale, partial, zeroed, or previous-round parameters.
evidence: Corrupted clients are completely quarantined; if all clients fail, previous global weights are returned cleanly without division by zero.

description: All aggregated parameter tensors must correspond to compatible model structure, shape, dtype, and semantic position.
evidence: ModelService.set_parameters and fl_engine.aggregate_parameters validate layer count, layer shapes, and flat element count, strictly raising ValueError on mismatch.

description: Global and local model tensors must not share mutable references where independent state is intended.
evidence: Parameters are decoupled across serialization boundaries (ModelWeights.flat_weights list) and fresh torch tensors are constructed on model loading.

description: Round metrics must be calculated from the intended model and intended evaluation data.
evidence: Metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, f1, auc_roc, loss) are evaluated under torch.no_grad(); single-class edge cases fallback truthfully to 0.5 AUC.

description: Requested FL configuration must actually control runtime behavior (seed, lr, non-IID alpha).
evidence: Dirichlet alpha controls label skew monotonically (smaller alpha produces statistically higher cross-client label variance); seeds produce deterministic partitions.

description: Published round and final state must describe the execution that actually occurred.
evidence: Round events, participating clients, aggregation durations, and test evaluation metrics are published accurately via WebSocket and stored in DB repository.
